On September 10, a mandatory evacuation was ordered for Brindlemark and Ferris Hollow and the alert level was raised from Yellow to Orange.
Halvern Dam and the right abutment were damaged.
Roughly 11,800 residents were evacuated from Brindlemark, and people were evacuated from Ferris Hollow and the alert level was raised from Yellow to Orange.
People were evacuated from Brindlemark during evacuation and displacement operations.
Sorrel Basin Water Authority provided information during emergency communications.
